seed: Frozen WS15 source; its rejection retained, no unchanged retry
hypothesis: Immutable native matrix storage/layout metadata avoids repeated MPS property calls and local autorelease pools in alias/layout/inventory checks while retaining WS15 exact lazy-default storage retirement. No attribution of prior slowdowns or assumed speed gain.
source_evidence: metal_context.mm constructs MetalMatrix::Impl and assigns its matrix at one Allocate site only. MetalMatrix copies share the same Impl; no external Objective-C mutation API. Numeric buffer/device identity is valid only while its Impl owns the MPSMatrix; no extra retained buffer or process-global pointer cache.
change: Default-OFF CACHED_MATRIX_METADATA requires LAZY_RESIDENT_DEFAULTS; cache numeric identity/device/rows/columns/rowBytes/offset/length/allocated bytes at allocation. SharesStorage, CompatibleLayout, IsDefaultLayout and MatrixBufferInfo use cached values. All other pools, host operations, encoding, model/runtime source and native arithmetic unchanged. C++ live-property audit test runs outside timing.
validation: OFF/ON native references + metadata/live property parity across empty/copy/move/reassignment/distinct same/different padded shapes, host update/zero, pending GPU output/Submit/Abort and surviving another context. Full32VLM/28text finite states/tokens/prefix/capacity/vision; ordinary/resident graph alternation, two sessions, close/rebuild/invalid controls and partial allocation faults.

protocol.resource: Fresh8realWorldSensecalls >=10% sampledMetal and >=5% sampled process footprint, exact/golden/native/identities.

tradeoffs: Extra numeric metadata per matrix; allocation-time properties and checks counted in initialization. Pointer identities are not physical residency proof. Does not optimize GPU arithmetic; host savings may be immaterial. All old rejected runs retained. No source/build/GPU/archive jobs during performance. Preserve CUDA, BF16/FP32, context/image budgets and exact output gates.
